column1: # THE CPAN BOARD'S POPULATION -- versioned (s515c, task #2950).  Read by
# tools/cpan-board.sh TREE OUTPREFIX, which every board run uses (the agents'
# legs, Fable's merge legs and the shared base result alike), so the list can
# never drift between two copies of a shell loop again.  The blessed row
# baseline is baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv (its NAME is kept: the tooling
# and the docs point at it; its population is THIS file's).
# dist  = a directory name under ~/.cpan/build, or a repo-relative path (it
#         contains a `/`) resolved against the TREE being measured.
# flags = `-` or `--no-dist-lib` (the dist's lib/ is NOT put on @INC: an
#         XS-stubbed dist whose lib/ would shadow PCL's must-win shim), or
#         `--inc=DIR,DIR` (extra @INC dirs for this dist only, relative to
#         ~/.cpan/build: a dependency's lib/ fetched there and never
#         installed, the dist's own inc/ that its `make test` adds; s518e).
# joined = the session the dist joined the board.
# why   = one line: what the dist exercises.
# HOW A DIST JOINS (docs/cpan-release-plan.md "Widening the board"): run it
# EVERY failing row's got/expected; probe the cause vs perl; cite a task or
# file one; add the rows BY HAND with their causes to cpan-board14-fails.tsv;
# a TIMEOUT gets its hang filed and a `*FILE*` row; then add the line here and
# re-run the whole board once (0 NEW / 0 FIXED against the blessed rows).
